operations.source_name: Ordnance Survey coordinate tools and resources
operations.details_summary: Official OS resources define OSTN15/OSGM15 as the high-accuracy transformation route and provide developer packs, raw grids and test resources.

operations.source_name: Ordnance Survey coordinate tools and resources
operations.details_summary: OS states that users needing transformation accuracy better than 3 metres should use OSTN15 and OSGM15 rather than a simple transformation; simple transforms are rejected for exact parcel geometry QA.

OSTN15 links ETRS89 to OSGB36 British National Grid and OSGM15 links GNSS ellipsoidal height to national mean-sea-level height datums; these models remain the accepted transformation contract for any GNSS-derived crosscheck.

OSTN02/OSGM02 and OSTN15/OSGM15 provenance must not be mixed silently. Historical survey lineage keeps its recorded transformation metadata while current conversion QA uses the current national models.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency Survey Data Catalogue GeoPackage metadata index guidance
operations.details_summary: EA states that LiDAR Composite downloads now include a GeoPackage spatial metadata index describing spatial location and temporal extent of the raster elevation data.
Parcel evidence must bind the sampled raster to the metadata-index record covering the exact location and survey temporal extent; product-wide dates alone are insufficient lineage.
The switch from Shapefile to GeoPackage is a metadata-delivery format change and does not itself alter elevation values, survey dates or parcel measurements; no numeric mutation is inferred.
Where repeat surveys exist, the exact survey/tile lineage used by the composite remains required for reproducibility; a newer catalogue record cannot silently replace SHA-bound raster evidence.

operations.source_name: OS transformation + EA spatial metadata lineage QA
operations.details_summary: Row 30762 remains 0.270 m at 96% confidence; historical transformation metadata and exact survey lineage are preserved, together with the existing absolute-95 caution.

operations.source_name: OS transformation + EA spatial metadata lineage QA
operations.details_summary: Row 46142 remains 0.831 m at 96% confidence; transformation/version and spatiotemporal-lineage gates do not modify the measured raster range.

operations.source_name: OS transformation + EA spatial metadata lineage QA
operations.details_summary: Row 61522 remains 0.490 m at 96% confidence; the narrow absolute margin remains disclosed and exact survey lineage stays mandatory.
The new transformation and lineage contracts strengthen reproducibility controls but do not justify changing the three SHA-bound DTM measurements.
All four guarded-recovery receipts remain absent from the canonical branch; no second runner, business promotion or fabricated export is created.
Recovery remains fail-closed while the external path is not verified compliant with the contract prohibition on reset --hard.
